name: Spatial Freq Temporal
description: Analyzes spatial 频率 temporal stability
algorithm: Spatial Freq Temporal — Frequency Domain Analyzer
mechanism:
This method analyzes the temporal behavior of spatial frequency content across video frames for deepfake detection:

1. **Per-Frame空间频率分解**: Each frame is decomposed into spatial frequency bands via 2D FFT or wavelet transform. The energy at each spatial frequency is tracked over time, creating a 3D representation (spatial frequency × orientation × time).

2. **频率稳定性分析**: For static regions, the spatial frequency content should remain stable across frames. The method measures temporal variance at each spatial frequency. Deepfake generation may produce temporally varying frequency content — particularly at high frequencies where generation artifacts fluctuate frame-to-frame.

3. **人脸-Background频率相干性**: The temporal behavior of spatial frequencies in face regions vs. background should be similar (same imaging pipeline). The method compares temporal frequency stability between regions. Different temporal stability characteristics indicate different generation/capture sources.

4. **频谱Flicker检测**: The method detects temporal oscillations in specific spatial frequency bands. These "spectral flickers" can arise from: (a) GAN training instabilities producing oscillating artifacts, (b) autoencoder quantization varying between frames, (c) frame-rate conversion creating frequency-domain beating patterns.

5. **NaturalImageStatistics时间一致性**: Natural images follow the 1/f spatial frequency power spectrum (scale invariance). This relationship should hold consistently across frames. The method tracks the spectral slope over time — systematic temporal variations in the 1/f exponent indicate processing artifacts from AI generation.
parameters:
分析类型: 频率
媒体: 视频
输入: Video frames extracted at key intervals
输出: 置信度分数 (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 中到高 — 70-88% 独立准确率. Most effective when combined with other 视频 forensic methods. Performance depends on 视频 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 视频 through spatial freq temporal analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 视频 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 视频 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 视频 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 视频 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 视频

references.title: Zheng, Y. et al. (2021). Exploring Temporal Coherence for More General Video Face Forgery Detection. ICCV.
Verdoliva, L. (2020). Media Forensics and DeepFakes: An Overview. IEEE JSTSP.
